name: Reeve Halda
text: An orc reeve who keeps the peace in Rubblegate, a settlement dug out of a fallen city's gatehouse, and pays those who help her keep it.

name: Factor Imre
text: A gnome trader with business all along the border, and never enough couriers he can trust.

name: Warden Osk
text: An old goblin warden who watches the passes for raiders and paladins.

name: Ysolde the Necromancer
text: She keeps the crypt under the Lady's old chapel, and she can call the dead back up out of it, for a price or a service.

name: Brother Aldo
text: A grey-robed Priest of Death, a partial necromancer and healer who raises no undead. His mortuary can send the dead back for a while, for crowns or for service; the Lady is patient.

name: Vashti of the Pits
text: An elf necromancer who works the plague pits under Cinderhold. She was one of his, once; she does not say how willingly.

name: Mother Skrell
text: A goblin blood priestess who keeps Gutterwick's temple to the Blood God. Her god takes crowns, or service, and gives back what the grave took.

name: Elder Gorvash
text: An old orc who leads Cinderhold's council. He remembers the binding, and fears whoever finds a way to use it first.

name: Foreman Tikka
text: A goblin who runs Gutterwick's work gangs and road crews, and pays for anything that keeps the roads open.

name: Archivist Sefa
text: An elder elf who keeps what books she could carry out of the Night Archive. She says she was a saboteur in the Dark Lord's service; no one can prove it, and few believe her.

name: Saltwarden Brask
text: A broad orc who runs the salt pans that keep Saltwick alive, and pays in salt or crowns, whichever you would rather carry.

name: Sister Orla
text: A grey-robed Priest of Death, a gnome, who keeps Saltwick's mortuary. She has buried more of the Pale Reach than anyone alive, and lately some of them have not stayed buried.

name: Gaffer Nim
text: An old goblin who walks bread up to the Saltgate every week. His mother is the sergeant there, and she still does not know him.

name: Ferrywoman Grut
text: A one-eyed goblin who poles the ferry across the Mire. She has lost two boats and a nephew to whatever lives in the old cisterns, and she wants it dead.
